verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents installation, composition, packaging, and drift-correction features but contains no mention of a destroy/teardown operation or documentation on deleting/decommissioning provisioned resources or entire environments. Since Crossplane is an infrastructure-provisioning control plane, a clean teardown capability is a fair expectation, but nothing in the pack demonstrates it. missing for 10: any docs or community evidence on deleting/uninstalling managed resources or environments, confirmation that resource deletion cascades cleanly, and any CLI/kubectl-based teardown workflow.
